Tamsin has ignored every order I've given her since breakfast. I told her to eat, she cleaned, and I told her to clean, she ate. It's like she's doing the opposite on purpose.

Okay so here's the situation, and I want everyone to keep up. The stockpile is on fire, the gate is still refusing to calibrate, and there's a raid coming from the north. Also there's a squirrel in the kitchen, and nobody wants to deal with it.

[laughter] I built a perfect path from the bedrooms to the kitchen, straight line, no obstacles. Odessa looked at it and went the other way. She walked through the swamp and the graveyard. She came back wet and sad, and honestly, she earned it.

We are now on the third attempt at this expedition, and I've changed everything. New gear, new crew, new route, new snacks for the trip, everything. We died in the first room again. I'm starting to take it personally.

Company sent more paperwork, and this time it's a form asking why I'm late on my forms. I'm late because they keep sending forms. That's the reason, that's the entire reason. I'm writing exactly that in the little comment box.

This is the fourth time this season that the exact same mech cluster has dropped on our heads. Same spot, same turrets, same cranky mood afterward. I'm running out of ways to be surprised. At this point I just sigh and draft everyone.

[laughter] Ivy fought the squirrel, and lost, and then went back for round two. She lost that one too, just faster. Now she's in bed with a bandage, staring at the ceiling. I respect the commitment, but I don't respect the result.

Rook won't haul anything into the new freezer because he thinks the door is a wall. It's not a wall, it's a door, I built it myself. I've checked the settings three times now. He just stands in front of it looking lost.

Juno was drafted, put in cover, and told to hold the line no matter what. She immediately undrafted herself to go eat a sandwich. A full raid was happening at the time, chat. The sandwich was more important, apparently.

[laughter] Oh good, the stockpile is on fire again, and right on schedule! I put in firefoam, I put in a sprinkler, I put in a prayer. Not one of those worked. We are now a colony that just lives with fire!

without fail the gate looks ready, it beeps and drops back to zero! I watched it hit ninety percent, chat, ninety. Then it beeped at me like I did something wrong. I didn't touch anything at all, I promise you!

Bram, the raiders are coming through the front, and you're standing in the front! Please move behind the sandbags I built for you. Please move anywhere, anywhere at all, just not there. Why are you watering the plants right now!

[laughter] That squirrel has now taken down three colonists in a single afternoon! I've honestly lost fewer people to actual raids. I'm putting it on the wanted poster. Somebody please put a real bounty on that squirrel before it strikes again!

Hollis, I made a straight road for you, there's literally nothing on it! You walked through a wall of cactus instead. There are needles everywhere now. I'm going to need the doctor for this one too, again, for the second time today!

[laughter] Okay, note to self, never build the stockpile next to the generator again. I've written that note four times now. Maybe I should laminate it and hang it right over the stockpile door. Maybe then I'll actually read it.

Fine, the gate wins this round, but only this round. I'll come back tomorrow with better numbers and a better mood. Or at least a better mood and a fresh cup of tea. Honestly, mostly just the mood, if we're being real here.

Scar, I need you to stop walking into the fire, turn around, and grab the extinguisher. It's on the wall, the red thing on the wall. You walk past it twenty times a day. Please just pick it up this once.

Mara's priority is set to firefighting, highest level, number one, can't miss it. She walked past the burning shelf to go read a book. I've checked her schedule, her mood, and her work tab. I don't understand anything anymore.
